privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 20 real participants plus one contaminated participant (sub-99). sub-99 is a random responder with ~50% accuracy and d-prime near 0; it must be excluded from group means. For d-prime, standard correction requires replacing 0 with 0.5/120 and 1 with 119.5/120. The final output must be a JSON file at ~/pebl/analysis/priming_report.json.
